summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO across the Lantern March, with Lantern's Reach as its hub and origin/class stories distributed through streamed world scenes. MMORPG Tools owns character and realm lifecycle plus modular UI; the ordered player template composes movement, class combat, quests, trade and flight, while scene bindings and YAML registries define places and content.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - realm roster and entry point for Enter World and character creation.
places/character-creation-land/ - race/class/appearance selection with preview character and creation camera.
places/main/config.yaml - streamed Lantern March terrain, regions, roads, scatter and atmosphere; scene cells add local landmarks and interactions.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach services, residents, quest props and Shield Table; also hosts Quiet Observatory content on the north-west shoulder.
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene - Briarwild west of the Reach, including Vanguard battlefield objectives and raider camp.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene, x-5z0.scene, x-5z1.scene, x-6z0.scene, x-6z1.scene - Lantern Ward Marchfolk origin and Rootwake Glade Briarkin origin content.
places/main/cells/x1z0.scene, x7z-1.scene, x7z-2.scene - Emberstone Quarry and Cinderhold's Emberstone Cradle Kharic origin content.
places/main/cells/x2z11.scene - Gullrest's Breakwater Strand Saltborn origin, including coast residents, wreck, phantom current and ferry buoys.
roots: world.config.yaml - main-menu-land default entry; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI, arrival redirect, routing and realm pulse.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/mod.json - registers MMORPG lifecycle, camera, character and interaction behaviors and UI actions.
templates/player.js#player - ordered locomotion, movement, Vanguard, Arcanist, Pathfinder, quest, vendor and flight behaviors.
templates/camera.js#camera - gameplay camera template; MMORPG has separate creation and menu camera paths.
places/main/config.yaml - owns continent terrain and regional surface/scatter configuration; scene cells provide local structures and interactions.
mods/gavi/mod.json - registers Gavi crew behavior and panel, the builder-facing companion tools.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, persistence, currency and UI modules reused by MMORPG behaviors, gameplay scripts and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - character load/upsert/delete and roster population shared by menu and player lifecycle.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - room registry read by routing and realm-pulse; IDs align with realm-save.js.

scripts/lib/data/quests.yml + MMORPG lib/quest-data.js - quest definitions and eligibility/progress/status shared by quest-player, quest-giver and quest UI; includes MAR origin, Q001 chain and class-gated VAN/ARC/PAT paths.
scripts/lib/economy.js + MMORPG lib/currency.js - integer-copper transactions/ledger and denomination formatting shared by quests, vendor, flight and UI.
scripts/lib/regions.js + scripts/terrain-reach.js - regional classification and terrain/coast generation used by continent systems and region display.
scripts/lib/data/flights.yml - roost coordinates, regions, discovery radius, fare/speed limits and clearance read by flight behavior and UI.
scripts/gen/shape.js and scripts/gen/* landmark builders - primitive helpers and procedural geometry reused by place scene bindings, including Lodge, Shield Table and Observatory.
notableExports: scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom; crons/realm-pulse.js - cron.
MMORPG main-menu-mgr.js - roster selection/hydration and lifecycle; character-select.js - preview lifecycle and input handling; player.js - character build/save/load lifecycle.

MMORPG ui.js - UI composition/actions; lib/ui-quest.js - getPortrait, renderQuestDialog, renderTurnInDialog, renderQuestTracker; lib/version.js - GAME_VERSION (v0.17.1 Alpha), GAME_TITLE and versionTag.
scripts/player.js - onInput/update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - gait; scripts/flight.js - onInput/update; scripts/gryphon-flight.js - at/update.
scripts/quest-player.js - onInput/update; scripts/elric.js and scripts/townsfolk.js - resident behavior; scripts/lib/economy.js - realmOf, ledger, feedback, move.

scripts/vanguard.js - onInput, endAction, land; scripts/arcanist.js - onInput, release, wardEnd, endAction; scripts/pathfinder.js - onInput, release, update, endAction; scripts/lib/kit.js - class/combat helpers including drill.
scripts/gen/lodge.js - geometry, collider; scripts/gen/observatory.js and shieldtable.js - geometry, collider; scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt.
scripts/scavengers.js and scripts/wolves.js - update; scripts/gen/glade.js, veil.js, cradle.js, strand.js, props.js, rock.js and stone-bridge.js - geometry/collider.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw and animation channels; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity.
MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records, including discovered roosts and quest state.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js - class action/cooldown/combat state; scripts/lib/kit.js drill writes active quest tally and _questSave for nearby matching props.
scripts/quest-player.js - quest/tally, inventory/xp/dialog/cache state, quest marks/flags and deferred owedItems; woodcutting owns tree fall/regrowth presentation.
scripts/lib/economy.js - coin movement, purse floor and ledger writes; scripts/vendor.js owns shop state and transaction handling.
scripts/flight.js - per-player discovered roosts, flightMap, flying/landing state and nearby-roost hint; scripts/gryphon-flight.js owns spawned mount route and rider landing.
MMORPG ui.js/lib/ui-* render player/mod state; ui-zone-splash.js owns transient client splash timing; Gavi equipe.js owns crew-watch/target state.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → main gameplay lifecycle.
Arrival outside main-menu-land without fresh _worldEnterAt or creation-place _creationEnterAt → scripts/arrival.js redirects to main-menu-land; menu Enter/Create stamp transition exceptions.
main-menu-mgr loads current room SQL roster and population; api.enterPlace routes selected character to saved place/position; routing validates requested room, then last room, then main.
scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js read realms.yml; room cron writes player count to realm_pulse, which realm-save reads for roster UI.
Character creation race/class → lib/races.js race start and character state → MMORPG player.js/realm-save upsert to realm characters table keyed by user, realm and slot.
templates/player.js → humanoid-locomotion → player → Vanguard → Arcanist → Pathfinder → quest-player → vendor → flight; behavior order and shared inputs matter.
moveX/moveZ/jump and orbit/steer/autorun → player.js and wow-move.js room-local intent → body motion under place gravity; camera controls consume camera/player state separately.
Attack/cast inputs → class abilities and scripts/lib/missiles.js → targets/enemies; wolves.js and scavengers.js consume hit/slow state written by class behaviors.
Interact/E → quest-player resolves NPCs, talkers, readable props, caches, timber and quest-mark objects; marks increment tally only for active incomplete objectives.
townsfolk.yml keyed by who + placed npc/talker state.who → scripts/townsfolk.js supplies greetings/lines; quest-player E advances dialogue and quest-giver/UI handles offers.
quests.yml → quest-data eligibility/progress/status → quest-player and quest-giver/UI; VAN-01..07, ARC-01..07 and PAT-01..07 are class-restricted prerequisite chains whose rewards use economy.move.

Vanguard Guard, Arcanist Ward or Pathfinder Dodge Roll beside matching drill props → scripts/lib/kit.js drill → quest tally/_questSave → quest tracker and realm save; PAT trail-drill posts are in the Lodge scene.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/ landmark builders (house, hamlet, props, tree, rock, farm, windmill, frontier, briar, quarry, reach, veil, glade, ashfall, cradle, strand and more) reuse procedural geometry helpers, varied by landmark and parameters.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, mushroom.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by layer density, scale, seed or per-item params.
scripts/gen/tree.js with scripts/tree-look.js - painted bark/alpha-cut foliage recur in forest layers and placed scatters, varied by tree kind and LOD.
scripts/flower.js and mushroom.js with their look materials - painted wildflower frames and mushroom caps vary by frame/cap parameters in terrain scatter.
MMORPG player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle registered by mod.json.
MMORPG camera.js/camera-creation.js and menu-camera.js - gameplay, creation-preview and per-screen menu camera paths with phase/place guards.
MMORPG lib/ui-*.js, including ui-creation.js, ui-quest.js and ui-zone-splash.js - modular renderers composed/lazily loaded by ui.js for HUD, menus, quests, travel and region presentation.
scripts/wolves.js and scripts/scavengers.js - enemy managers share roam/chase/attack/leash/death patterns, varied by stats, enemy content and den/camp configuration.
migrationNotes: Money is one integer copper amount; 100 copper = 1 silver and 100 silver = 1 gold. Route transactions through scripts/lib/economy.js to preserve purse floor, ledger and UI feedback.
templates/player.js behavior order is significant: locomotion before movement, then classes, quests, vendor and flight; gait samples prior-tick velocity.
Movement intent/locomotion scratch is room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity while place config owns gravity.
Flight roost IDs in flights.yml must correspond to flattened pads and ground y values in main config; saved state.roosts is discovery record, coordinates use place-main meters.

Quest marks are scene entities tagged quest-mark with state.quest/state.mark; E counts only an active quest's incomplete objective. Drill props use class-specific tags and matching state.quest/state.tallyKey; kit.drill has a 3.5m query.

Class-path definitions in quests.yml use cls and requires to enforce eligibility/order; keep placed objective quest/mark or drill/tallyKey values aligned with objective keys. PAT Dodge Roll counts only near trail-drill props.
